model.description: Optional compatible same-provider model; mutually exclusive with offering.

submit_schema.description: Optional complete bounded submission schema; validated before child creation.

ai_callback_delay.description: Seconds before waking; default 3, zero immediate. Does not cancel.

max_output_bytes.description: Positive inline report cap; default 16384. Full output stays on disk.

working_context_tokens.description: Optional positive working input-token limit; saved before the first task, bounded by known model capacity.

offering.description: Exact registered route. Mutually exclusive with model; never changes credentials or falls back.

primary_skill.description: Exact primary skill from the creator's catalog. Starts with that primary's dependencies, not inherited startup selections.

confined.description: Confine a fresh child's commands and file tools to its assigned child directory. Project files and writable caches belong there.

process_read_paths.description: Explicit read-only command imports. Omitted inherits; empty drops imports. A confined creator cannot widen access. New launch options require a fresh child ID.
